wins.text: Q4 revenue grew 36% YoY and 14% sequentially to $828M, exceeding the high end of prior guidance by over 900 basis points
U.S. commercial revenue grew 64% YoY and 20% sequentially to $214M in Q4; full-year U.S. commercial TCV booked hit a record $803M, up 134% YoY and 170% sequentially
Adjusted operating margin expanded to 45% in Q4, the strongest in company history, driving a Rule of 40 score of 81 — a 13-point sequential increase
Q4 adjusted free cash flow of $517M (63% margin); full-year adjusted FCF of $1.25B (44% margin)
Q4 TCV booked of $1.79B, up 56% YoY and 63% sequentially, including 32 deals worth $10M or more; U.S. commercial customer count grew 73% YoY to 382 customers

risks.text: International commercial revenue grew only 3% YoY in Q4; Europe specifically cited as 'anemic' at ~4% growth on 13% of the business, with no near-term catalyst for acceleration
Strategic commercial contract revenue declining sharply — expected to fall to $4M-$6M in Q1 2025 vs. $24M in Q1 2024, and to represent only ~0.5% of full-year 2025 revenue
Significant increase in 2025 operating expenses expected as company invests in technical hires, which could pressure near-term margins despite strong top-line growth
DeepSeek-R1 and broader AI arms race with China highlighted as a national security risk; potential sanctions evasion via GPU sales in Singapore flagged as a concern
One-time $131M SAR-related expense accelerated in Q4, causing GAAP operating margin to compress to just 1% for the quarter, creating noise in reported earnings

guidance_items.detail: Q1 2025 revenue guided to $858M-$862M; full-year 2025 revenue guided to $3.741B-$3.757B (midpoint $3.749B), representing ~31% YoY growth — above prior implied trajectory
U.S. commercial revenue guided to exceed $1.079B in 2025, representing at least 54% YoY growth
Full-year 2025 adjusted income from operations guided to $1.551B-$1.567B, implying ~41-42% adjusted operating margin vs. 39% in FY2024
Adjusted free cash flow guided to $1.5B-$1.7B for full-year 2025 vs. $1.25B in FY2024
GAAP operating income and net income committed for each quarter of 2025

Speed of AI sales cycles and whether the pace of customer conversion is surprising to management
